meaning:
ἔν-νομος, -ον
[in LXX: Sir, Pro.1:1-33 ogue 12* ;]
1. lawful, legal (MM, Exp., xiii): Act.19:39.
2. Of persons,
(a) law-abiding;
(b) under law: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, 1Co.9:21 (Cremer. 435).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
